title: Blinking Bauble Bobtail
statement: Nestled in a twilight cove of smooth basalt columns and swaying golden kelp, this plump, thumb-sized squid spends its days meticulously sorting shards of sunken sea-glass into intricate, ever-changing spirals. Whenever a visitor leans close to the tank, its velvety mantle ripples with shifting constellations of bioluminescent light, flashing a warm and curious greeting.
